definition: The selected conditions or design are converted into machine instructions (G-code, a robot script). Used only when the paper describes this as a separate step.

name: dispense_liquid
definition: Dispensing a liquid, or adding a reagent.

name: dispense_solid
definition: Weighing and adding a solid.

name: clean_equipment
definition: Rinsing flow paths, nozzles or vessels with solvent between experiments.

name: mix
definition: Stirring, shaking or mixing.

name: sonicate

name: react_thermal

name: react_flow

name: react_photo_electro

name: anneal
definition: Heat treatment of a film or solid.

name: cool_quench

name: preheat
definition: Bringing a flow or vessel to temperature before the reaction (a preheater).

name: filter
definition: Filtration.

name: centrifuge
definition: Centrifugation.

name: wash_extract
definition: Washing, extraction or phase separation.

name: evaporate_dry
definition: Evaporation or drying.

name: purify

name: deposit_coat

name: assemble_device

name: measure_optical
definition: Spectroscopy such as UV-vis, photoluminescence (PL), IR or Raman.

name: measure_structural

name: measure_separation_ms
definition: Analysis such as HPLC, GC or MS.

name: measure_imaging

name: measure_electrochemical
definition: Electrochemical measurement, or conductivity.

name: measure_physical

name: analyze_data
definition: Computing the target value from measurements, or updating a model.

name: handle_sample
definition: Opening or closing caps, labelling, storage.

name: sample_aliquot

name: liquid_handler
definition: Pipetting robot, dispensing head.

name: solid_dispenser
definition: Powder dispenser, automated balance.

name: fluidics
definition: Syringe or peristaltic pumps and valves of a flow system.

name: batch_reactor
definition: Vial or well-block reactor, or a stirrer or heating block on which vials stay during the reaction (may heat and stir).

name: flow_reactor
definition: Tube or chip flow reactor.

name: thermal_unit
definition: Hotplate, oven, furnace, chiller.

name: mixer
definition: A device that only mixes, such as a shaker, vortex mixer or ultrasonicator.

name: separation_unit
definition: Centrifuge, filtration device, evaporator.

name: coating_printing_unit
definition: Spin coater, blade coater, printer.

name: assembly_unit
definition: Assembly device such as a coin-cell crimper.

name: instrument_optical
definition: Spectrometer (UV-vis, PL, IR, Raman).

name: instrument_structural
definition: XRD, XPS or NMR instrument.

name: instrument_separation_ms
definition: HPLC, GC or MS instrument.

name: instrument_imaging
definition: Microscope, camera.

name: instrument_electrochemical
definition: Potentiometer, impedance analyser.

name: instrument_physical
definition: Balance, thickness gauge, pH meter.

name: storage
definition: Rack, hotel, refrigerated storage.

name: sample_handling_station
definition: Capping and decapping device, plate sealer, waiting deck.

name: commercial_integrated

name: software
definition: Program for experiment planning or data analysis.

name: human

name: unmapped
definition: A module whose type fits no class of this taxonomy.

name: fixed_tubing
definition: Flow through a fixed tubing connection.

name: robot_arm_gantry
definition: Fixed robot arm, XYZ gantry or rail.

name: mobile_robot
definition: Mobile robot.

name: human_transfer

name: data_transfer

definition: Application field: polymers and soft materials.

definition: Application field: nanomaterials.

definition: Application field: batteries and electrochemistry.

name: catalysis
definition: Application field: catalysis.

name: biology_biochem
definition: Application field: biology and biochemistry.

name: analytical_chemistry
definition: Application field: analytical chemistry, i.e., optimisation of an analytical method such as HPLC or flow-injection analysis.

name: unmapped
definition: Application field that fits no tag of this list.

name: E_not_paper
definition: Not an original research article: news item, press release, correction or erratum, editorial, table of contents, cover.

name: E_review
definition: Review, survey, perspective, tutorial or conceptual architecture without its own closed-loop campaign.

name: E_off_topic
definition: Not about automated experimentation (e.g. 'autonomous' means something else).

name: E_duplicate_version
definition: Another version (preprint, journal version, other-language version) of the same study is the record; the link is in paper_version_link.

name: E_computational
definition: The loop runs on simulation or computation; physical experiments only validate predictions.

name: E_software_only
definition: The contribution is software (lab operating system, orchestration layer, LLM agent, planner) and no algorithm-chosen iteration on physical experiments is shown.

name: E_no_robot
definition: The loop is algorithm-driven but the experiments are carried out by people, or only one tool is programmable and no integrated hardware is described.

name: E_measure_only
definition: The loop only chooses what or where to measure; no sample is made or processed in the loop.

name: E_open_loop
definition: Automated experiments, but the conditions are not chosen by an algorithm from earlier results (fixed design of experiments, high-throughput screen, one-shot ML prediction, human-made decisions, feedback only for endpoint detection).

name: E_not_closed
definition: A platform or module paper whose loop is claimed but no algorithm-driven campaign or iteration is reported, or the loop is evaluated only retrospectively.

name: E_hardware_not_described
definition: Closed loop with automated hardware, but the hardware configuration is not described in the main text or SI (only cited elsewhere).

name: E_researcher_read
definition: The researcher read the full text and judged the candidate ineligible.

name: E_unretrievable
definition: No full text could be obtained (a web item without a DOI).
